name: Interest
definition: Consideration, such as amount of money,  paid or received in exchange for an asset that has been invested, loaned or borrowed for a certain period. The interest is expressed as a fixed amount or percentage of the amount upon which the interest is applied.

AccruedInterestAmount.name: Accrued Interest Amount
AccruedInterestAmount.definition: Interest amount that has accrued in between coupon payment periods.

Amount.name: Amount
Amount.definition: Amount of money representing interest payments.

Rate.name: Rate
Rate.definition: The actual interest rate used for the payment of the interest for the specified interest period.

CreditDebitIndicator.name: Credit Debit Indicator
CreditDebitIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the interest is a debit or credit.

PaymentDate.name: Payment Date
PaymentDate.definition: Date of the next interest payment.

TypeOfInterest.name: Type Of Interest
TypeOfInterest.definition: Specifies the type of interest associated with a trade.

InterestCalculation.name: Interest Calculation
InterestCalculation.definition: Calculation parameters used to obtain the interest amount.

RelatedCashProceedsDefinition.name: Related Cash Proceeds Definition
RelatedCashProceedsDefinition.definition: Cash proceeds definition for which an interest is provided.

SecuritiesFinancing.name: Securities Financing
SecuritiesFinancing.definition: Specifies the financing trade on which this interest apply.

RelatedInterestManagement.name: Related Interest Management
RelatedInterestManagement.definition: Management of interest which consists into calculating the interest, requesting its payment or distributing the interest proceeds.

RelatedUndertakingAmount.name: Related Undertaking Amount
RelatedUndertakingAmount.definition: Undertaking amount for which an interest is specified.

RelatedDebitCreditFacility.name: Related Debit Credit Facility
RelatedDebitCreditFacility.definition: Debit and credit facilities on which the interest applies.

SecuritiesSettlement.name: Securities Settlement
SecuritiesSettlement.definition: Securities settlement process for which an accrued interest is specified.

InterestName.name: Interest Name
InterestName.definition: Interest rate expressed as a rate name.

RelatedAssetHolding.name: Related Asset Holding
RelatedAssetHolding.definition: Asset holding on which interest is paid.

Deposit.name: Deposit
Deposit.definition: Deposit for which an interest is specified.

AccountBalance.name: Account Balance
AccountBalance.definition: Balance for which an interest is calculated.

RelatedAccountContract.name: Related Account Contract
RelatedAccountContract.definition: Account contract for which interest parameters are specified.

RelatedNetAssetValueCalculation.name: Related Net Asset Value Calculation
RelatedNetAssetValueCalculation.definition: Net asset value calculation for which an accrued interest is specified.

RelatedPaymentCard.name: Related Payment Card
RelatedPaymentCard.definition: Payment card for which interest on due amounts is specified.
